determination: Run 37532036039 proves exact-name input and Save success UI. A narrow read-only query found one campaign-owned network pattern persisted at the same run time with the generated-name shape. Thus persistence succeeded, while the side-panel read-after-write observation failed. The receipt has no active Patterns-tab, host, loading, row-count, or error state, so it cannot distinguish a missed tab switch, a pending/failed list fetch, a domain mismatch, or an unreadable row. Source shows the driver clicked Patterns immediately while SaveAsPattern's success popover remains open for 1200 ms, and it waited on whole-document text without confirming tab activation. This is a proven observability gap, not proof that the popover caused the miss. D47 replay and lifecycle remain unverified.
change: The driver already uses a hit-tested click and explicit selectAll to enter the exact save name, then scopes replay to its row. It now waits for the Save popover to close before switching tabs, requires the Patterns tab and pane to become active, and waits for the exact named row on the expected fixture host. During the live wait it retains only bounded tab, host-match, loading, row-count, empty-state, and categorized-error facts for the failure receipt; it does not log names or raw errors.
